## Social Media Crisis Detector
Runs every 15 minutes. Monitors Twitter for crisis-related keywords mentioning your brand, detects volume spikes, assigns severity levels, and sends Telegram + email alerts when a crisis threshold is exceeded. All events are logged to Google Sheets.
